children: Our Bureau Bengaluru: Coforge has appointed global executive search firm Egon Zehnder to identify a new chairman and two additional independent directors, following the board unrest with two exits last week of the mid-tier IT firm's chairman Om Prakash Bhatt and Nomination and Remuneration Committee (NRC) chair DK Singh.

The existing board spoke to analysts on Monday, headed by interim chairman Vivek Sharma, who said he will oversee the process to elect a permanent chair but he would not be a candidate for the role. Sharma has been appointed as the interim chairman until January 31, 2027. On September 8, Bhatt resigned with immediate effect, following concerns around an internal audit over the company's board evaluation process under his watch.

title: Coforge Appoints Egon Zehnder for Board Search
